name: Enmesh
description: Two combs pushed into each other until the teeth of one fill the gaps of the other.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 22%, 25% 22%, 25% 50%, 100% 50%, 100% 72%, 0 72%); clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 22%, 25% 22%, 25% 50%, 100% 50%, 100% 72%, 0 72%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(100% 22%, 100% 50%, 25% 50%, 25% 22%); clip-path: polygon(100% 22%, 100% 50%, 25% 50%, 25% 22%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
